tags.instructions: Obtain field IDs with `get-form`. Use `create-submission` for one response. Supply 1–10 submissions for a single form per call. This is not guaranteed atomic or safely replayable. Returned items are provider-confirmed records, not per-input success statuses; do not assume positional correlation. If the outcome is uncertain, inspect `list-submissions` before retrying.

tags.instructions: Use `get-form` to obtain the form's question and other field IDs. Supply native JSON answers appropriate to each question type, not encoded text. Use `batch-create-submissions` for 2–10 submissions to the same form. Creation can produce duplicates if repeated; check `list-submissions` before retrying an uncertain result. Payment and scheduling inputs record supplied details; they do not establish a charge or calendar booking.

functions.name: delete-submission
functions.description: Delete one submission from its form. The API does not document a restore operation or guarantee recoverability.

formId.description: Opaque identifier of the form containing the submission.

submissionId.description: Opaque identifier of the submission to delete from this form.

FunctionInput_fillout_deletesubmission.description: The form and submission to target for deletion.

deleted.description: The provider returned its documented successful deletion response; not a recoverability guarantee.

FunctionOutput_fillout_deletesubmission.description: Receipt for a submission deletion confirmed by the provider.

tags.instructions: Use formId from `list-forms` and submissionId from `list-submissions` or `get-submission`. This removes the response, not the form. Do not assume it can be undone or that linked payments or calendar events are canceled. Inspect the correct response before deleting if identity is uncertain.

functions.name: delete-webhook
functions.description: Remove an existing Fillout webhook registration so it no longer remains registered to receive submission notifications.

webhookId.description: Opaque identifier of the existing webhook registration, as retained by its creator; if originally supplied numerically, use its exact decimal text.

FunctionInput_fillout_deletewebhook.description: The existing Fillout webhook registration to remove.

deleted.description: The provider confirmed removal of the registration; not a guarantee that no in-flight notifications remain.

webhookId.description: Identifier of the webhook whose removal was confirmed.

FunctionOutput_fillout_deletewebhook.description: Confirmation that Fillout removed the identified webhook registration.

tags.instructions: Use only to remove an existing webhook, not to create or renew notification delivery. Obtain webhookId from the integration that originally registered it; there is no webhook-list tool. Removal does not delete submissions or the receiver endpoint. Already dispatched notifications may still arrive, and undo is not provided by this tool.

includeEditLink.description: Request an edit link on returned submissions; default false. A link may enable editing.

submittedBefore.description: Return submissions before this instant, with an explicit UTC marker or offset. Provider boundary inclusivity is not guaranteed.

tags.instructions: Find formId with `list-forms`. Use this to browse or find submissions; use `get-submission` when the submission ID is already known. Each call returns one page, with limit 1–150 (default 50). Pass nextCursor back as cursor without changing other inputs. Default results are finished, non-preview submissions in ascending provider order. Request edit links only when needed; these links can permit response editing.
